annotations.title: List a user's favorite beers, breweries and venues

description: List a user's favorites from the cache only — NO API call. Each item appears ONCE with every source that names it (sources: "derived" = qualifies from their cached history, "manual" = added with untappd_favorite_add, "untappd" = a brewery the user likes/follows on Untappd, mirrored by untappd_sync_brewery_likes — breweries only: Untappd has no followed/favorite venue list) and a reason ("liked on Untappd (since 2021-03)", "12 check-ins since 2015", "avg 4.1 across 9 beers", "manual: <note>"). Derived rules, each overridable via thresholds: venue = ≥5 check-ins OR visits spanning ≥3 distinct months (ranked by check-ins); brewery = ≥5 beers had AND avg rating ≥3.75, OR ≥15 beers (ranked by count blended with rating); beer = rated ≥4.25 OR had ≥3 times. Derived favorites are only as complete as the syncs behind them (untappd_sync_user_venues, untappd_sync_user_beers); "untappd" ones as the last untappd_sync_brewery_likes (freshness.brewery_likes). Filter by kind and source. Omit username for your own account.

thresholds.description: Override the derived-favorite thresholds (each optional; omitted ones keep their defaults).

beer_min_times_had.description: …or had at least this many times (default 3)

brewery_min_beers.description: Brewery: at least this many beers had… (default 5)

brewery_min_beers_any_rating.description: …or at least this many beers regardless of rating (default 15)

venue_min_checkins.description: Venue: at least this many check-ins (default 5)

venue_min_months.description: …or visits spanning at least this many distinct months (default 3)

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

name: untappd_favorites_list
